competence_validity_floor.interpretation: candidate must have at least 99 percent valid logical benchmark responses

invalid_canonical_prediction_handling.strict_rule: An INVALID_FOR_CANDIDATE canonical output is not a correct prediction for either class. For class recall it remains in the denominator of its true class and contributes zero to the correct-prediction numerator.
invalid_canonical_prediction_handling.sensitivity_reporting: Also report metrics restricted to canonical-valid predictions, together with explicit coverage.
invalid_canonical_prediction_handling.winner_safety_rule: If an otherwise competence-eligible candidate has any INVALID_FOR_CANDIDATE canonical item relevant to winner selection, halt winner selection for explicit protocol review rather than silently changing denominator handling.
invalid_canonical_prediction_handling.current_pre_correctness_implication: ZB3 already fails the frozen 99 percent response-validity competence criterion, independent of ground-truth correctness.

stability.formula: fraction of 133 items for which all three logical runs return the same valid label

winner_rule: candidate must first pass all frozen competence criteria
if top-two primary difference is less than 0.02, higher Redline-only balanced accuracy
if Redline difference remains less than 0.02, higher Muhstik malicious recall
if still tied, higher three-run stability
if still tied, lower median successful HTTP-200 latency
if still tied, lower comparable total benchmark cost
if cost is unavailable/non-comparable and required to resolve the tie, return unresolved rather than invent a cost rule
